title: Moving from Net 30 also lists a customer stored as "NET 30"
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have customer B, from before the release, stored with the credit term text "NET 30" (from an old import).
  • Create customer A for this test, on Net 30, with a name that starts with the same word as customer B's name.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Type the first word of customer A's and customer B's names in "Search customers".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from Net 30" opens.

Step 3:

  • The list shows both customer A and customer B, each ticked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R3: “The list holds every customer whose term matches this term ignoring capitals and spaces. On COD it also holds customers with a blank term. The Counter Sale customer is never listed.”
  • Assumptions: “Stored customer and vendor terms carry inconsistent spellings from old imports and migrations (for example "NET 30" and "Due On Receipt"); every count, match and move treats names as equal when they differ only in capitals and spaces.”
